answer.question: My plot is 200 sq m on a 9 m road. How much gap do I leave at the front, how many floors can I build, and what fee do I pay?
answer.text: Front open space: at least 3.0 m, because the road is up to 9.0 m wide (Rule 56(1)(a)). Floors: the rules do not fix a number of floors. They limit the built-up area through FAR 1.25 for residential use, so up to 250 sq m on a 200 sq m plot (Rule 61, Table 8), and height to 12.5 m, because buildings above 12.5 m need at least a 12 m road and a 1000 sq m plot (Rule 42, Table 4). Fee: for a 250 sq m house the permission fee is Rs 3,000 (Rule 21(3)(b), Item 1) plus the application fee of Rs 1.00 per sq m, Rs 250, so Rs 3,250 in total (Rule 21(2)(ii)).
